ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
ayahs.e2: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺
ayahs.tr: Yaw ayyuhal muzzammil

ayahs.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little
ayahs.e2: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—
ayahs.tr: Qumil laila illaa qaleelaa

ayahs.ar: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
ayahs.e2: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less
ayahs.tr: Nisfahooo awinqus minhu qaleelaa

ayahs.ar: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
ayahs.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation
ayahs.e2: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way
ayahs.tr: Aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil Qur'aana tarteela

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلࣰا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation
ayahs.tr: Innaa sanulqee 'alika qawalan saqeelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـࣰٔا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
ayahs.e2: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation
ayahs.tr: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحࣰا طَوِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation
ayahs.e2: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺
ayahs.tr: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion
ayahs.e2: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
ayahs.tr: Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs
ayahs.tr: Rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرࣰا جَمِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance
ayahs.e2: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously
ayahs.tr: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa

ayahs.ar: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little
ayahs.e2: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while
ayahs.tr: Wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالࣰا وَجَحِيمࣰا
ayahs.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire
ayahs.tr: Inna ladainaaa ankaalanw wa jaheemaa

ayahs.ar: وَطَعَامࣰا ذَا غُصَّةࣲ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰا
ayahs.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment
ayahs.e2: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺
ayahs.tr: Wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down
ayahs.e2: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand
ayahs.tr: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولࣰا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولࣰا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh
ayahs.tr: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna Rasoolna

ayahs.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذࣰا وَبِيلࣰا
ayahs.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure
ayahs.e2: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip
ayahs.tr: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمࣰا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired
ayahs.e2: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey
ayahs.tr: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba

ayahs.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
ayahs.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled
ayahs.e2: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled
ayahs.tr: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way
ayahs.e2: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
ayahs.tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa

ayahs.ar: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
ayahs.e2: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
ayahs.tr: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem
